'''RamapoCon II Booster Draft''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck (booster draft) held in Ramapo College, New Jersey on 6 May 2000. [[Chris Erwin]] won it. It is known from Chris Gogolen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d707">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cgd707/ ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cg], DeckTech (Chris "CGogolen" Gogolen, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapoconii-day-2-trs-from-cgd707/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[RamapoCon II]].

* '''Date:''' 6 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Ramapo College, New Jersey
* '''Format:''' [[Booster Draft]]
* '''Players:''' 36
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Erwin]]
